component.name: XTA Native
component.summary: Private, read-only reader for X and other networks

description.p: XTA Native is XTA, the private, read-oriented way to browse X. It reads X and other sources, such as Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, Substack and RSS feeds, and never posts, likes or shares anything in your name. The accounts you follow, your groups, saved posts and likes stay on this computer.

ul.li: Timelines of the accounts you follow, in groups you arrange
Several timelines side by side in a wide window, and a deck of columns
Saved posts with notes, offline articles and downloads
No trackers: XTA Native talks only to the sites you read
